title: Uruguayan-Style Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful, plant-based twist on a classic Uruguayan dish. Perfect for a satisfying vegan meal.

ingredients.name: roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, zucchini, and onions

instructions: Wash and chop the sweet potatoes into 1-inch cubes. Toss with a tablespoon of oil and roast for 45 minutes.
While the sweet potatoes are roasting, heat a tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the roasted vegetables to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the aromatic rice to the skillet and stir to combine. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Warm the pillowy bread slices by baking them in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
Assemble the Uruguayan-Style Rice Bowl by placing a scoop of the rice mixture on each plate, topping with roasted sweet potatoes, and drizzling with uruguayan chimichurri.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional chimichurri if desired.
